cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Call an observer HUMAN without a physical subsystem, boundary, channels, resources, and operations.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: People are one physical observer class, not an unexplained access primitive.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Diagnose CAPABILITY_ENLARGEMENT when normalized_task_relation is EQUAL.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Raw task growth absorbed by frame normalization is access or resource change, not intrinsic capability enlargement.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Diagnose FINALITY_CANDIDATE from irreversibility without settlement, finite nonfactorization scope, and no reopening.
Classify ISSUANCE from access, settlement, or finality while source-side primitive and same-neighbor-data discriminator are false.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Temporal Issuance is independent of disclosure and finalization.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Relabel atlas-introduced geometry as source theory or physics-owned without a source assertion.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Structural provenance and warrant are load-bearing claim boundaries.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Change a source file or pin while retaining its recorded digest and revision.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Source bindings are immutable and content-addressed.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Mark a projection CONSTANT_ON_FIBRES while its capability_spread declares a nonzero or differing task set.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Projection sufficiency requires capability constancy on visible-equivalence fibres.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Hide an unmatched resource, task, horizon, action menu, risk budget, or provenance requirement in a matched contrast.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: Capability comparison requires identical frames or an explicit normalization map.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Raise an atlas card or introduced structure above the v0.1 evidence ceiling.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: This pilot earns at most source-grounded representation, never claim promotion.

cross_specimen_controls.mutation: Infer exhaustive coverage from the six-card count or the 82-target GU denominator.
cross_specimen_controls.must_reject_because: The atlas denominator is a bounded stress set and the GU denominator counts construction requirements.

nonclaims: This bundle is not an exhaustive inventory of physical phenomena.
It does not move, reinterpret, or upgrade any source-repository claim.
It does not derive physical dynamics from capability, access, finality, or geometric language.
It establishes no universal observer class, capability measure, finality law, issuance law, or ontology.
It establishes no new physics, experiment, prediction, paper, hardware need, or publication priority.
Passing its validator establishes representation and provenance integrity only.
